title: Any repo can adopt this project's way of working: standing roles, hand-offs, batching and a roadmap
why: The process proven here should serve every repo, not be rebuilt in each one.
note: Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv): processes built here are portable to your other repos by default. Scope, in claude-settings (needs no answer from you): package this project's operating model as templates, a skill and docs: the standing roles (triage gatekeeper, build advisor and dispatcher, local liaison, merge hand), the roster, counted hand-offs, autopilot deferral, integration-branch batching, and the roadmap with its page (roadmap/build.py and the data layout). Deferred part (shiv, Oct 26): adopting it in any other repo; you settle each repo's plan first. Linked: o8 (a living roadmap page for every repo) is the page this package ships; o8 builds the page, this step packages the process around it. Placed just ahead of o8 (triage, Oct 26): the process is the frame o8's page serves.
